<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/products/{sku}/classification"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the classification in the same shape inventory-storage used,
plus `classificationSource` and `version`. 404
`product-classification-not-found` when the product exists but is not
classified; 404 `product-not-found` when the SKU is not registered.
